description: Golden Q&A set for RAGAS evaluation of the AuditSys AI financial/audit RAG agent. ground_truth is the reference answer used for faithfulness/answer_relevancy/context_recall scoring. answer/contexts are placeholder precomputed values for the fast, non-live eval path (`run_evals.py` without --live) — synthetic, not sourced from real indexed documents. Replace them with reviewed answer/contexts pairs captured from an actual run against real evidence before trusting non-live scores as a quality signal; until then, prefer --live for anything but a smoke test of the eval pipeline itself.

items.question: What is the total revenue reported for the most recent fiscal year?
items.ground_truth: Total revenue for the most recent fiscal year is stated in the income statement of the ingested annual report.
items.answer: Total revenue for the most recent fiscal year is reported on the consolidated income statement of the annual report.
contexts: Consolidated Statements of Operations: Total revenue for the fiscal year is presented as the first line item, followed by cost of revenue and gross profit.

items.question: What is the company's net income for the current reporting period?
items.ground_truth: Net income for the current reporting period is disclosed on the consolidated income statement.
items.answer: Net income for the current reporting period is disclosed as the bottom line of the consolidated income statement.
contexts: Consolidated Statements of Operations: Net income (loss) attributable to the company is reported after income tax expense and non-controlling interests.

items.question: What were the total operating expenses last quarter?
items.ground_truth: Total operating expenses for last quarter are broken out in the operating expense note of the filing.
items.answer: Total operating expenses for last quarter are broken out by category in the operating expense note.
contexts: Note 4 — Operating Expenses: Operating expenses consist of research and development, sales and marketing, and general and administrative expenses, summed for the quarter.

items.question: Does the audit report contain a going concern qualification?
items.ground_truth: The going concern status is stated explicitly in the auditor's opinion section of the audit report.
items.answer: The auditor's opinion section of the audit report states explicitly whether a going concern qualification applies.
contexts: Report of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm — Opinion: We have audited the accompanying financial statements... In our opinion, the financial statements present fairly... [going concern paragraph, if applicable, follows the opinion paragraph].

items.question: What internal control deficiencies were identified in the most recent audit?
items.ground_truth: Identified control deficiencies are listed in the internal controls / management letter section of the audit report.
items.answer: Identified control deficiencies are listed in the internal controls (management letter) section of the audit report.
contexts: Management Letter — Internal Control Matters: During our audit we noted the following deficiencies in internal control over financial reporting, listed by severity and remediation status.

items.question: What is the current ratio based on the latest balance sheet?
items.ground_truth: The current ratio is current assets divided by current liabilities, both reported on the latest balance sheet.
items.answer: The current ratio equals total current assets divided by total current liabilities, both reported on the latest balance sheet.
contexts: Consolidated Balance Sheet: Total current assets ... Total current liabilities ... (both subtotals reported separately from non-current items).

items.question: Who is the engagement partner listed on the audit opinion?
items.ground_truth: The engagement partner's name appears in the signature block of the audit opinion letter.
items.answer: The engagement partner's name appears in the signature block at the end of the audit opinion letter.
contexts: Report of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm — signed on behalf of the firm, with the engagement partner's name in the signature block along with years served as auditor.

items.question: What accounting standard framework was used to prepare the financial statements?
items.ground_truth: The framework (e.g. US GAAP or IFRS) is disclosed in the basis of presentation note.
items.answer: The accounting framework used (e.g. US GAAP or IFRS) is disclosed in the basis of presentation note to the financial statements.
contexts: Note 1 — Basis of Presentation: These financial statements have been prepared in accordance with [US GAAP / IFRS] as issued by the applicable standard-setting body.

items.question: Were there any related-party transactions disclosed in the filing?
items.ground_truth: Related-party transactions, if any, are disclosed in the related-party transactions note.
items.answer: Related-party transactions, if any, are disclosed in the related-party transactions note to the financial statements.
contexts: Note — Related Party Transactions: The company engaged in the following transactions with related parties during the period, including terms and outstanding balances.

items.question: What is the total value of vendor payments flagged for missing dual approval?
items.ground_truth: The total value of flagged vendor payments is summarized in the procurement exceptions report.
items.answer: The total value of vendor payments flagged for missing dual approval is summarized in the procurement exceptions report.
contexts: Procurement Exceptions Report: Payments processed without evidence of dual approval, aggregated by vendor and total value for the reporting period.

items.question: What is the effective tax rate for the period?
items.ground_truth: The effective tax rate is disclosed in the income tax note as a percentage of pre-tax income.
items.answer: The effective tax rate is disclosed in the income tax note, computed as income tax expense divided by pre-tax income.
contexts: Note — Income Taxes: A reconciliation of the statutory tax rate to the effective tax rate is presented, along with the effective rate as a percentage.

items.question: What material weaknesses, if any, were reported in internal control over financial reporting?
items.ground_truth: Material weaknesses are described in the ICFR assessment section of the filing.
items.answer: Material weaknesses, if any, are described in the internal control over financial reporting (ICFR) assessment section of the filing.
contexts: Management's Report on Internal Control over Financial Reporting: Based on this assessment, management concluded that internal control over financial reporting was [effective / not effective], noting any material weaknesses identified.

items.question: What is the total long-term debt outstanding at period end?
items.ground_truth: Total long-term debt is reported on the balance sheet and detailed in the debt note.
items.answer: Total long-term debt outstanding at period end is reported on the balance sheet and detailed further in the debt note.
contexts: Note — Debt: Long-term debt consists of the following instruments, with outstanding principal, interest rate, and maturity date for each.

items.question: Were any subsequent events disclosed after the balance sheet date?
items.ground_truth: Subsequent events are disclosed in the subsequent events note, if applicable.
items.answer: Subsequent events, if any occurred after the balance sheet date, are disclosed in the subsequent events note.
contexts: Note — Subsequent Events: Management has evaluated events occurring after the balance sheet date through the date the financial statements were issued.

items.question: What is the policy threshold requiring dual approval for procurement transactions?
items.ground_truth: The dual-approval threshold is defined in the procurement policy document.
items.answer: The dual-approval threshold for procurement transactions is defined in the procurement policy document.
contexts: Procurement Policy, Section — Approval Authority: Transactions above the defined dollar threshold require approval from two authorized signers prior to payment.

items.question: What was the auditor's overall opinion type (unqualified, qualified, adverse, disclaimer)?
items.ground_truth: The opinion type is stated at the top of the auditor's report.
items.answer: The auditor's overall opinion type is stated at the top of the auditor's report, under the Opinion heading.
contexts: Report of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm — Opinion: In our opinion, the accompanying financial statements present fairly, in all material respects... (unqualified), or otherwise as qualified/adverse/disclaimer.

items.question: What is the gross margin percentage for the most recent fiscal year?
items.ground_truth: Gross margin percentage is gross profit divided by revenue, both on the income statement.
items.answer: Gross margin percentage for the most recent fiscal year equals gross profit divided by total revenue, both reported on the income statement.
contexts: Consolidated Statements of Operations: Revenue ... Cost of revenue ... Gross profit (revenue less cost of revenue).

items.question: Are there any pending litigation matters disclosed in the notes?
items.ground_truth: Pending litigation is disclosed in the commitments and contingencies note.
items.answer: Pending litigation matters, if any, are disclosed in the commitments and contingencies note.
contexts: Note — Commitments and Contingencies: The company is party to various legal proceedings arising in the ordinary course of business, described below with estimated exposure where determinable.

items.question: What is the cash and cash equivalents balance at period end?
items.ground_truth: Cash and cash equivalents balance is reported on the balance sheet.
items.answer: The cash and cash equivalents balance at period end is reported as a line item on the balance sheet.
contexts: Consolidated Balance Sheet — Current Assets: Cash and cash equivalents ... (first line item under current assets).

items.question: What vendor onboarding exceptions were identified and what is their status?
items.ground_truth: Vendor onboarding exceptions and their remediation status are listed in the vendor onboarding exceptions report.
items.answer: Vendor onboarding exceptions and their remediation status are listed in the vendor onboarding exceptions report.
contexts: Vendor Onboarding Exceptions Report: Vendors onboarded without complete documentation, with exception type, identified date, and current remediation status.
